newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon PM Hariri's government resigns.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon PM Hariri's government resigns.

text.p: Lebanese Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri and his government resigned on Tuesday to make way for the formation of a new government following recent parliamentary elections.
"The mandate of the council of ministers has ended according to the constitution so this government has resigned," Hariri said after a meeting with President Elias Hrawi.
Hariri, a billionaire construction tycoon in power since October 1992, is expected to be reappointed and head the new government after the new parliament meets on October 22 to elect a speaker.
